title: Ginger Muffins
description: Light, airy muffins with a warming gingery kick, made from self-raising flour, golden caster sugar and a can of ginger beer.
steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C/180°C fan. Put paper muffin cases in ten holes of a 12-hole tray.
Sift the flour into a bowl and stir in the sugar.
Slowly pour the ginger beer into the flour mixture (it will fizz). Beat thoroughly until smooth but not too thick — like pancake batter.
Pour into the muffin cases, filling each around two-thirds full.
Bake for 30 minutes, or until risen and just starting to brown. Eat hot or cold.
notes: Makes 10 muffins. Per muffin estimate. Use the most intensely flavoured ginger beer you can find.
